## Fixed: Live crashing on converted Live 10.1 / 11.0 sets

Converting a set last saved with **Live 10.1** or **Live 11.0** to VST3 produced a set that made Live 12 crash right after opening it. The converter added a field to the converted plug-ins that only Live 11.2 and later write.

Live has changed how it stores VST3 plug-ins a few times (in Live 11.2, 11.3 and 12). The converter now writes exactly what the set's own Live version writes, and when the set already contains VST3 plug-ins, it copies their layout.

If an earlier version produced a set that crashes Live, delete that converted version and convert the original again with 0.3.2. Sets converted from projects saved in Live 12 weren't affected.

This is the first release built automatically by GitHub Actions.
